svg.title: Gizmo: Vending Trouble
svg.desc: A small vending machine slides in beside Gizmo. He flicks a purple chip into its slot and waits. Nothing drops. He leans over and taps it, then shoves it twice so it rocks. Still nothing. He gives the viewer a flat look, pops into a baseball bat, winds up, and swings into it. The machine lurches, rumbles, and dumps its whole stock: cans shoot out of the tray at the bottom and pile up across the floor until he is buried to the brow, with one eye showing through a gap. The pile shakes and his lower tip curls up out of it on his left, holding a single can aloft. The machine slides away, the cans clear, and he pulls the tip back in. Nine second loop on a transparent background.
